<h2>CDT Weekly Newsletter</h2><br><ul><li><p>Applications Open for BDFI&rsquo;s Research Sandpit</p></li><li><p>Have Your Say: World Caf&eacute; 2027</p></li><li><p>Active Outreach Training</p></li><li><p>Robogals Bristol: Seeking Female Alumni Speakers</p></li><li><p>Enabling Spaces for Collective Intelligence</p></li><li><p>All Impact Club</p></li><li><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities</p></li><li><p>Hold the Date: CDTs End of Year Meeting, Lunch and Goldney Grotto Tour</p></li><li><p>How Can Money Be Used as a Force for Good?</p></li><li><p>Postdoc opportunity: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate in AI-Driven Environmental Modelling</p></li><li><p>Postdoc opportunity: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate in AI-Driven Environmental Modelling</p></li></ul><p><p>Welcome to this week's issue of the newsletter.</p></p><br><br><b><p>Applications Open for BDFI&rsquo;s Research Sandpit</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Application deadline: 5pm, Monday 2 November</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The Bristol Digital Futures Institute (BDFI) is offering three grants of up to &pound;10,000 each to support pilot immersive projects with the potential to attract larger-scale future funding. University of Bristol academics and PhD researchers are invited to attend a sandpit event on 8 December 2026, 9am&ndash;5pm, to develop interdisciplinary projects addressing public challenges using BDFI&rsquo;s immersive facilities, including the Reality Emulator and XR suite.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Projects may explore areas such as sustainability, training or public health. Funding can cover research, events, travel and staffing, and technical support may be available, so no prior technical expertise is required.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://us.list-manage.com/1AAEyamCkn6?e=f73c8a8ff3&amp;c2id=5481753dd6a28b86cbbebc932f88678e">Find out more about the BDFI Research Sandpit and apply</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Have Your Say: World Caf&eacute; 2027</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Expression of interest deadline: 10am, Wednesday 4 November</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The World Caf&eacute; is a knowledge-sharing event that brings together PhD students from Science and Engineering CDTs to discuss common research challenges, exchange advice and share experiences across different stages of the PhD journey.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The next event is tentatively planned for early March 2027. Students are invited to complete a short expression of interest (EOI) survey to indicate whether they would like to attend and share their views on the event format, including the venue and whether it should be a half-day or full-day event.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=MH_ksn3NTkql2rGM8aQVG3FfF-cg0MdHrP6aK23YdaBUQVZKTEs0UjJPRFRKUzkzSTY4WVRBNE9DMS4u">Complete the World Caf&eacute; student EOI survey</a> by 10am on Wednesday 4 November.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Find out more about previous events: <a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/composites/news/2025/world-cafe.html">World Caf&eacute; 2025</a> and <a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/engineering/news/2023/world-cafe.html">World Caf&eacute; 2023</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Active Outreach Training</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Would you like to deliver academic taster sessions for school or college-age students? The Widening Participation Team is offering Active Outreach training to help academic staff and postgraduate researchers develop the confidence and practical skills to plan and deliver engaging, inclusive outreach activities.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><a href="https://us.list-manage.com/Zvhj7IKj6IL?e=f73c8a8ff3&amp;c2id=5481753dd6a28b86cbbebc932f88678e">Find out more about upcoming Active Outreach sessions</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Robogals Bristol: Seeking Female Alumni Speakers</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The University of Bristol&rsquo;s Robogals Society is looking for female alumni to inspire the next generation of engineers and roboticists at a careers event on&nbsp;<strong>Monday 9 November, 6&ndash;7pm</strong>.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Alumni working in robotics, engineering, technology or related fields are invited to share their career journeys and insights with current students, helping to encourage more women to pursue careers in STEM. Previous involvement with Robogals is not required.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Interested in taking part? Email <a href="mailto:alumni-volunteers@bristol.ac.uk">alumni-volunteers@bristol.ac.uk</a> to find out more.</p><br><br><b><p>Enabling Spaces for Collective Intelligence</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>Wednesday 11 November 2026, 2 - 3pm, MVB 2.59 and SRB 3.315, or </strong><a href="https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/346487569903319?p=tP9fICcxPS64nwASdc"><strong>online via Microsoft Teams</strong></a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The School Seminar Series launches with a talk by Seth Bullock, Head of the Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Research Group. The series will showcase research across the School, providing opportunities to exchange ideas and identify potential collaborations.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">In this talk, <em>Enabling Spaces for Collective Intelligence</em>, Seth will explore how physical space shapes collective behaviour, from group-living animals and social networks to pandemics. He will discuss how spatial constraints can not only limit interactions but also help enable effective collective intelligence systems.</p><br><br><b><p>All Impact Club</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>17 November 2026, 2:00pm - 3:00pm,&nbsp;</strong><a href="https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/349494041831294?p=WCteB3y43YxNVQCaKZ"><strong>Online (Microsoft Teams)</strong></a></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The All Impact Club brings together colleagues interested in research impact to share knowledge, discuss current topics and learn from impact activities across the School and beyond. Each session will focus on a different topic.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">For the first session, Ruzanna, School Research and Impact Director, will present a REF impact case study and explain the distinction between REF impact and broader forms of research influence and engagement.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">If you have suggestions for future topics or would like to contribute to a session, please contact <a href="mailto:cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk">cs-staff-enquiries@bristol.ac.uk</a>.</p><br><br><b><p>Bristol Doctoral College (BDC) Events and Opportunities</p></b><br><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="mso-add-space: auto; text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: normal; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 21.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><strong style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><span style="mso-bidi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">1.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span></strong><!--[endif]--><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Beyond the Thesis: Academic Funding Landscapes</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">3 November 2026, 10:30&ndash;11:30am, Online via Teams</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Planning a future academic career? This online session offers a high-level introduction to the UK academic funding landscape, particularly for second- and third-year full-time PhD students.</span></p>

Questions are welcome throughout via Teams chat.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78466384;instance=20261103103000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here</a>.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="mso-add-space: auto; text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: normal; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 21.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><strong style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;"><span style="mso-bidi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">2.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span></strong><!--[endif]--><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">ND PGR Speed Friending</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">5 November 2026, 4:00&ndash;5:30pm | Senate House (PGR Hub)</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Looking to meet fellow postgraduate researchers in a relaxed and welcoming setting? </span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Join the Neurodivergent PGR Network for a structured social event open to all PGR students. <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78488515;instance=20261105160000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Booking is preferred</a> but not required. you can still attend without it.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="mso-add-space: auto; text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: normal; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 21.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><strong><span style="mso-bidi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">3.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span></strong><!--[endif]--><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Beyond the Thesis: Academic CVs</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><strong><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Tuesday 10 November | 10:30&ndash;11:30am | Online via Teams</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">Join the Bristol Doctoral College for an introductory session on building a strong academic CV, particularly suited to full-time PhD students in their second or third year.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">The session will explore the purpose and structure of an academic CV, helping you identify relevant skills gained during your research, present them with appropriate context and evidence, and tailor your CV to specific academic roles. Questions are welcome throughout via Teams chat.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78466386;instance=20261110103000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here</a>. </span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI'; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="mso-add-space: auto; text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: normal; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 21.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><strong><span style="mso-bidi-font-family: Aptos; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-latin;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">4.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span></strong><!--[endif]--><strong><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;">Writing Precisely and Concisely</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><strong><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;">16 November 2026, 10:00&ndash;12:00, Senate House (PGR Hub)</span></strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;">A clear, concise abstract or summary can help communicate the value of your research. This workshop is open to postgraduate researchers at any stage of their degree and will explore techniques for writing more precise and engaging abstracts and summaries. You&rsquo;ll also have the opportunity to draft your own abstract or receive peer feedback.</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; background: white; vertical-align: baseline; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 18.0pt;"><span style="color: black; mso-color-alt: windowtext;"><a href="https://www.bristol.ac.uk/doctoral-college/events/#event=78450453;instance=20261116100000?popup=1&amp;lang=en-UK">Book your tickets here</a>.</span></p><br><br><b><p>Hold the Date: CDTs End of Year Meeting, Lunch and Goldney Grotto Tour</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Please save the date for our&nbsp;<strong>CDTs End of Year Meeting</strong> on <strong>Wednesday 16 December</strong>. The day will include an opportunity to reflect on the year, enjoy lunch together, and take part in a special tour of the <strong>Goldney Grotto</strong>.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><em>Further details and a calendar invitation will follow, but for now, please keep the date free in your diary.</em></p><br><br><b><p>How Can Money Be Used as a Force for Good?</p></b><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><strong>2 December 2026,</strong><span style="font-family: 'inter',serif; color: #333333; background: #F8F8F8;"> </span><strong>6:30 - 7:45pm, Bill Brown Forum, Sloane Robinson Building</strong></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">Join Mark Clayton of Triodos Bank UK for a public talk hosted by Professor Martin Parker of the University of Bristol Business School, exploring how money can be used as a force for good.</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The talk is open to University staff, students, alumni and members of the public. Friends, family and colleagues are also welcome.</p>
